description: This PHP class defines the LDAPSyncStatusDecorator which provides a decorator for managing and formatting LDAP synchronization status data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting the synced user by user ID and retrieving formatted sync start and finish dates/times.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps LDAPSyncStatus entity to provide additional functionality for formatting synchronization timestamps and linking to user references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the decorator with an LDAPSyncStatus entity.

methods.name: setSyncedUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the sync operation, identified by user ID.

methods.name: getSyncStartedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the sync process.

methods.name: getSyncStartedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted start time of the sync process.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted finish date of the sync process.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted finish time of the sync process.
